decision_rule: CLEARS iff SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound > 0 AND SLU-F1 delta >= THE NULL AND intent CI95 lower bound >= -(intent guard); a clear licenses registering an arm with an in-chain A/A
headroom: ENTITY-FP-ONLY 10.8 % of DEV-2000-ADDED rows (12.1 % of Fold A), bad-case bank via the synthesis; an upper bound on the rows the rule can help, never a forecast

pool.beside: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-2-FOLD-A-V1 once its stage 1-3 read exists (--pool fold-a)

stage3_algorithm.note: One fixed rule read once over a sealed pool: no rollout, no credit assignment, no update operator, no search and no evolving store. Deliberately NOT labelled sealed-credit-system-policy-v1, whose first instance every single-factor cell of this programme leaves to the composed system policy.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-EMPTY-ENTITY-OFFLINE-V.note: 0.53 is the gate's offline floor at n = 1,000 -- the smallest effect registered to be seen, not a forecast. The registered decision bar is the pool's own measured null (step 1), which may be larger.
SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-EMPTY-ENTITY-OFFLINE-V.primary_metric: official pooled SLU-F1 (micro), RULE-mean-single minus R0-mean-single over the sealed ROLL-3 pool; intent the guard

status: OFFLINE DESIGN; DRAFT exposure row, root countersignature pending; no flight registered; not yet run

step_1_null.intent_guard_definition: mean over the ten pairs of the intent half-width
step_1_null.not_the_null: instrument note section 2e's whole-utterance cluster widths (1.19 per-row / 1.56 pooled micro, analysis.paired.resampled_statistic) are a different resampling unit; reported beside only with --with-cluster-variant
step_1_null.null_definition: mean over the ten pairs of the pooled SLU-F1 half-width (max reported beside)
step_1_null.quantity: paired CI95 half-width of the pooled official SLU-F1 (micro, word + char distance TP/FP/FN) between two sample indices, ten pairs; each sample vs R0-mean-single beside; per-row SLU, span-F1 and intent beside

resampling.baseline: R0-mean-single (the mean of the five unedited sample copies' count matrices)
resampling.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(20260915).integers(0, n, size=(10000, n)); per-draw weights by bincount
resampling.source: docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md sections 2c and 2d (the one-pool offline floor, 0.67 pp at n = 625, from the aggregation read's medoid rule)
resampling.unit: row (paired: every arm re-summed on the same draws)

step_1_null.sealed_before_step_2: null.json under analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-EMPTY-ENTITY-OFFLINE-V1/dev2000-added/; step 2 reads it and never re-derives it (instrument rule 6)

step_2_rule.rule: vote >= 3 -> every sample of the row delivered with an empty entity list, scenario and action unchanged; malformed samples never vote and are never edited
step_2_rule.vote: number of well-formed samples (of 5) whose answer carries no entity
